summary.headline: Fixed-Star Nativities
summary.text: Astrological delineations for five fixed stars, describing effects of Mars, Venus, Saturn, and Jupiter on sexuality, medicine, hidden knowledge, priesthood, prophecy, honor, fertility, and fame. Spica, the Northern Crown, and the Southern Fish are interpreted in relation to the ascendant, angles, midheaven, the Sun, Moon, and Lot of Fortune.
